description: Use when porting or debugging a 32-bit-era C/C++ game engine (DOOM 3 / idTech 4 here) on Windows x64 with a modern MSVC and no original SDKs - build-system bring-up, 64-bit pointer truncation hunts, runtime crashes that only appear with real game data, and proving a port works with scripted screenshot, log and audio evidence. Triggers on x64 port, LLP64, inline __asm, CMake from vcxproj, 0xC0000005 after the engine "links fine", silent audio, black or blank frames, "works with no data but crashes with data".
